note: ProCredit Bank Kosovo's price list for private clients (effective 19 January 2026): the Standard package costs 2 euros a month, free for its first 12 months, which the game doesn't track, so it's charged throughout; the Basic package is barred to anyone holding one at another bank in Kosovo.

sources.title: ProCredit Bank Kosovo, Çmimorja për klientë privatë (effective 19.01.2026)
sources.said: ÇMIMORJA PËR KLIENTË PRIVATË Data efektive: 19.01.2026 ... € 5.00/ € 2.00/ € 0.50/ € 0.00/ ... Pako Standard është pa tarifë mujore të mirëmbajtjes për 12 muajt e parë.
